purpose: Per-plate illumination (vignetting) correction so blank paper - streets, yards, vacant ground - reads the same tone everywhere. Presentation stage only; never applied to master_full.tif or any archival scan.

problem.observed: streets do not match across the sheet; dark bands run along every seam
problem.cause: each LOC plate was photographed with its centre brightest and its edges falling off (bound-volume vignetting). The falloff is per-plate and discontinuous at seams, so a street reads bright mid-sheet and dark near a join.

measured_master_space.note: intra-sheet exceeds between-sheet, so a per-sheet constant gain cannot fix it; the correction must vary within each plate

target.sample: Ave. G (Winnie) x 22nd St, open intersection, canvas x21800-22100 y6950-7300
target.why: chosen by the owner as the reference street tone. It also equals the page-wide paper mode (190.5,184.5,175.5) to within 1.5 levels, so overall page brightness is preserved and the D-016 tone-match anchors stay valid.
target.estimator_note: measured with the SAME bright-30% estimator the field uses; the earlier median value (191,186,176) would under-brighten everything

field.note: estimated inside each source region separately, by normalized convolution, so the field is never smeared across a seam
field.estimator: mean of the brightest 30% of a cell's paper candidates - a median is pulled down by grey fills and shading and over-brightens those cells

gain.why_multiplicative: preserves black exactly (0 maps to 0) and preserves hue, so ink stays ink and type legibility cannot fall
